items.title: Members of Parliament
items.description: Met with Members of Parliament from a range of countries to brief them on the human rights situation facing Eelam Tamils.

items.title: UN Human Rights Council, Geneva
items.description: Advocated in Geneva with the OHCHR, OSLAP and diplomatic missions ahead of Human Rights Council sessions to advance accountability and justice.

items.title: European Union
items.description: Met with EU officials from EEAS, EU Commission and members of the European Parliament to advocate for the withdrawal of GSP+ trade privileges from Sri Lanka and brief on accountability & justice concerns of Eelam Tamils.

items.title: Government Officials
items.description: Maintained continued engagement with government officials internationally to brief them on the current human rights situations of Eelam Tamils and provided policy recommendations.

items.title: Briefings
items.description: Provided research and briefing documents on pressing issues to policymakers and politicians to raise awareness on the accountability and justice process.
